criteria.name: Accuracy
levels: All claims supported, sources not recorded
Every claim traceable to a recorded source

criteria.name: Information gain
levels: Every major section adds a number, example, trade-off or first-hand point

criteria.name: Audience fit
levels: Right assumed knowledge and tone throughout

criteria.name: Specificity
levels: Claims carried by numbers, names and examples

criteria.name: Structure and format
levels: Right shape, weak opening or ending
Opens with the point, ends with an action, scannable

criteria.name: Readability
levels: Readable, some long or uniform stretches
Varied rhythm, plain words, reads well aloud

criteria.name: Cliché-free
levels: Several overused phrases or filler transitions

criteria.name: Honesty
levels: Claims match the evidence; limitations stated
